verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies versioning. An official agent skill migrates API client code "to the latest major version" across many languages, which suggests major-versioned clients. Official API clients fall under Algolia's SLA, and one user reports "no API changes" in long-term use. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, support windows, or explicit REST API versioning. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy and timelines, explicit API version scheme and changelog docs, and independent corroboration of versioning practices.
